heading.en: The last link in the chain

hook.en: You never buy toothpaste from the factory. You buy it from the shop round the corner. That shop is the retailer, the last link between producer and consumer.
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಟೂತ್‌ಪೇಸ್ಟ್ ಅನ್ನು ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಯಿಂದ ಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಿಂದ ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಆ ಅಂಗಡಿಯೇ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ, ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಮತ್ತು ಗ್ರಾಹಕರ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೊನೆಯ ಕೊಂಡಿ.

say.en: You never buy toothpaste from the factory. You buy it from the shop round the corner. That shop is the retailer, the last link between producer and consumer. In this lesson: Define a retailer.
Explain services of retailers to manufacturers and wholesalers.
Explain services of retailers to consumers.

body.en: A *retailer* is a business enterprise engaged in the sale of goods and services directly to the ultimate consumers. The retailer normally buys goods in large quantities from wholesalers and sells them in small quantities to consumers. Retailing is the final stage of distribution.
body.kn: ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಅಂತಿಮ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಕು ಮಾರುತ್ತಾನೆ.

title.en: On the board: Services of retailers

narration.en: The retailer is the last link: he buys in bulk from the wholesaler and sells small lots to the consumer.

say.en: The retailer is the last link: he buys in bulk from the wholesaler and sells small lots to the consumer.
To manufacturers and wholesalers he distributes goods, sells personally, collects market information and promotes products.
To consumers he keeps goods available, informs about new products, offers convenience, choice, after-sales service and sometimes credit.
The retailer is the last link: he buys in bulk from the wholesaler and sells small lots to the consumer.

explanation.en: The retailer is the last link in distribution: it helps producers and wholesalers reach buyers, and gives consumers availability, information, convenience, choice and service.

body.en: To manufacturers and wholesalers: retailers help in the distribution of goods, do personal selling, enable large-scale operations by taking over the job of selling to consumers, collect market information about tastes and preferences, and help in promotion through displays and sales campaigns. To consumers: retailers ensure regular availability of products, give information about new products, provide convenience in buying (nearby location, long hours), offer a wide selection, provide after-sales *services*, and sometimes give credit.
body.kn: ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು ಮಾರಾಟ, ಪ್ರಚಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹದಿಂದ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕರಿಗೆ, ಅನುಕೂಲ, ಆಯ್ಕೆ, ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟೋತ್ತರ ಸೇವೆಯಿಂದ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.

problem.en: A mobile phone shop in Shivamogga keeps phones of many brands, explains new models, repairs phones under warranty, and tells the company that customers want bigger batteries. Classify these services.

steps.en: Many brands to choose from: wide selection (to consumers).
Explaining new models: information about new products (to consumers).
Telling the company about battery demand: collecting market information (to manufacturers).

answer.en: Selection, information and after-sales service for consumers; market information for the manufacturer.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A mobile phone shop in Shivamogga keeps phones of many brands, explains new models, repairs phones under warranty, and tells the company that customers want bigger batteries. Classify these services.

say.en: Let us work through this together. A mobile phone shop in Shivamogga keeps phones of many brands, explains new models, repairs phones under warranty, and tells the company that customers want bigger batteries. Classify these services.
Many brands to choose from: wide selection to consumers.
Explaining new models: information about new products to consumers.
Warranty repairs: after-sales service to consumers.
Telling the company about battery demand: collecting market information to manufacturers.
So the answer is Selection, information and after-sales service for consumers; market information for the manufacturer.
